name: Norms Cocktails
notes: No website listed. Checked: Yelp business page (photo gallery has only 16 photos under Inside/Outside/All categories, no Menu tab or menu photos, category is Sports Bars/Dive Bar); web search of multiple aggregators (Tripadvisor, Facebook, San Diego Reader 403, Groupon 403, Untappd, restaurantji) found no priced food menu; two listed lookalike domains (norms-cocktails.menu-world.com, norms-cocktails.com-place.com) both 403 and read as directory-farm placeholders, not the restaurant's own site; restaurantguru and menupix are barred/blocked sources for this project without an independent second priced source, and menupix returned 402/403. Reviews describe it as a classic dive/sports bar (pool table, karaoke, jukebox) with only anecdotal mentions of burgers/chili and one review noting mixed drinks go for four dollars -- not a real per-item priced menu. No per-item prices found anywhere. Treating as a genuine drink-only dive bar with no published menu.

name: Hibachi-San
notes: No website listed; this is a base-exchange food-court concept at 200 Vandegrift Blvd, Camp Pendleton North. Confirmed the Yelp listing for this exact address/branch (hibachi-san-camp-pendleton-north-4) has zero photos and no menu tab. A PDF at wnam-cdn.menuweb.menu (menuweb.menu farm) lists this same address and 27 dish names (seaweed salad, poke bowl, sushi rolls, chicken teriyaki, etc.) but explicitly zero prices -- generic scraped listing content, not usable. hibachi-san.top is a barred .top domain (farm) and restaurantguru is barred without an independent priced source. A Grubhub listing for 'Hibachi-San' exists but is at 20846 Pacific Plz, Camp Pendleton -- a different branch/address than our 200 Vandegrift Blvd record, so excluded per branch-matching rule. No per-item prices found anywhere for this specific branch.

name: Dulzura Mini Market
notes: No website. This tiny hamlet market has only one location; work-list address ('17089 Can...') differs slightly from Yelp's listed '17023 California 94, Dulzura, CA' but the name matches exactly and Dulzura is a one-business unincorporated community, so treated as the same restaurant. Priced entirely from a fully legible, dated chalkboard menu photo attached to a 5-star Yelp review by 'Scott S.' dated May 5, 2026 (recent, within this project's window) -- read via Yelp's photo alt-text 'Menu' filter, not the barred Yelp Menu tab. All 23 items on the board were legible (verified 'Side Sourcream' price by cropping/zooming the image) and captured; prices are plus tax per the board. Sides split into their own section as shown on the board; everything else grouped as Menu.

name: Roger's Pizzerolo
notes: The restaurant's own Owner.com storefront carries a clean 4% online-ordering surcharge (verified: dividing every storefront price by 1.04 lands 85 of 108 items on round/.95/.99 endings, e.g. $29.11 -> $27.99, $25.99 -> $24.99), so it was not used directly. Instead priced from two fully legible, dated (Jul 25, 2026, recent) first-party trifold menu photos on Yelp -- address and phone (2990 Jamacha Rd, El Cajon; 619-230-5455) match exactly, and the photos themselves state 'LISTED PRICES ARE CASH. CARD PRICES MAY DIFFER', which explains the storefront's 4% online/card surcharge and confirms the photo prices are the true (cash) wall prices -- confirmed to the cent against the 1.04-corrected storefront figures. Captured every section on both trifold panels: Calzone & Stromboli, Sandwiches, Homemade Pastas, Pasta Deals, Salads (SM/LG), Appetizers, Side Orders, Specialty White Pizzas (14"/18"), Everyday Special, Pizza Deals, Build Your Own Pie, Desserts & Drinks, Pizza Pies (14"/18"), Specialty Pizza (14"/18"). Detroit Style Pizza section is likely partial -- only 'Cheese $21.99' was visible before the photo's right edge cut it off, so other Detroit-style flavors (if any) are not captured. Excluded pure modifier/upcharge lines (Extra Toppings, Extra Dressing, topping charge table) as they are not standalone dishes. crossCheckedAgainst is the Owner.com storefront, which agrees on item list and the confirmed 4% ratio.
